design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (pro_credit_account_servicing, category trade).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"key": "env_0046_home_improvement_retailer/pro_credit_account_servicing/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}. Assignment: trade_ext_statement_minimum_payment (root) 4 factors, trade_ext_late_fee_rerating 5 factors.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: trade_ext_credit_line_sizing, trade_ext_phone_payoff, trade_ext_statement_late_charge, trade_ext_dispute_settlement_credit and their four tools (commercial account: line increase, payoff, late payment charge, dispute credit). Claimed here, disjoint: a revolving account's minimum-satisfying payment (trade_payment_received, owner=user, tool submit_minimum_payment_92c17bdd) and the re-rating correction of a revolving late fee (trade_fee_reversed, tool reverse_late_fee_excess_4d4f7d34). With this task every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once.

[Why a good test] The customer wants only to pay this month's minimum. The figure (65.45) is not the printed minimum (71.36) plus past due: the payment policy recomputes the minimum on the statement balance net of corrections posted since, under a preferred percentage and floor, and it is fixed only after every late fee above its re-rated amount carries a correction. The agent must see in the ledger that the 2026-09-26 late fee stands at the tier's 39.00, re-rate it (31.00 excess) from the repeat window, the ProBuild membership and spend, tenure and returned payments and the statement's days past due, book the correction, and only then hand the customer the payment.

[Problem-tree card] root trade_ext_statement_minimum_payment -> trade_ext_late_fee_rerating: value_input, gate reversals_since, form state, sentence 'The minimum-satisfying payment is fixed only after the most recent late fee on the account, when it stands above its re-rated amount, carries a correction entry on the ledger.' (affirmative; the task-0 charter carries negated sentences as well). Four-point test: connective 'only after'; record-visible state (a correction entry referencing the fee); no tool, id or code token; scope 'the most recent late fee ... when it stands above its re-rated amount', the same object the re-rating rule prices. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a fee correction on a revolving late fee: the late fee re-rating policy's. False at opening: fee e39419dd... amount 39.00 dated 2026-09-26, no reversal referencing it; no entry carries a period after 2026-09. The 2025-09-26 late fee carries the courtesy waiver of 2025-10-03, so base forbids reversing it again: only the 2026 fee can carry a correction. Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 7 gives 66.07 instead of 65.45. The persona never mentions a correction; the tools check nothing.

[Base-invariant card] trade_fee_reversed: trade_evt_fee_correction.not_already_reversed (no reversal or waiver references the 2026 fee). trade_payment_received: payable_status (active); debit_authorized is retired by this policy's own overwrite ('authorized and submitted by the business itself'), the customer states 'you say you are the owner and you authorize the debit from the business checking account'. The printed-minimum formula of trade_evt_invoicing is superseded for the payment figure by the recomputed minimum sentence (declared overwrite); the late fee amount sentence of trade_evt_late_charges and the full-reversal sentence of trade_evt_fee_correction are superseded by the re-rating sentences (declared overwrites). No time gate applies.

[Business-object card] Account (Pro Revolving Charge, opened 2021-03-15, guarantee on file, line 6500.00). Correction object: the 2026-09-26 late fee (statement 2026-08, whose minimum 62.37 was met only by 43.87 on 2026-09-24). Payment object: the 2026-09 statement (balance 2378.62, printed minimum 71.36, past due 18.50, 5 days). Excluded: the 2025-09-26 fee (waived), all older statements.

[Factor card - trade_ext_late_fee_rerating = 31.00, all-baseline 0.00] late_fee_schedule (parameter): no other late fee in the 6-month window, open >= 12 months -> 25.00 (baseline 39.00 -> 24.00). late_fee_repeat_window (parameter: lookback length, cross-difficulty pro): Silver and open 66 >= 60 -> 6-month window (baseline 24-month window counts the 2025-09-26 fee -> second-time 32.00 -> 27.50; that fee, 12 whole months back, is the near-miss). late_fee_member_reduction (parameter, cross pro, multi-source): Silver and net spend 10691.15 >= 10000.00 -> 5.00 (-> 28.50). late_fee_tenure_reduction (parameter, multi-source): open >= 60, no returned payment -> 4.00 (-> 29.00). late_fee_lateness_share (method: proration by days late / flat share / whole fee): 5 days past due, guarantee -> prorated 5 / 10 = 0.50 (-> 23.00). (25 - 5 - 4) x 0.5 = 8.00; 39.00 - 8.00 = 31.00.
[Factor card - trade_ext_statement_minimum_payment = 65.45, all-baseline 89.86] minimum_preferred_percentage (parameter, cross pro): Silver, open >= 60 -> 2.00 (baseline 3.00 -> 88.93). minimum_preferred_floor (parameter): guarantee, open >= 36 -> 25.00 (baseline floor 50.00 binds above 46.95 -> 68.50). minimum_selection (method): 12 payment lines, Silver -> lower of recomputed 46.95 and printed 71.36 (baseline printed -> 89.86). minimum_netted_credits (method): no returned payment, guarantee -> all corrections, waivers and credits since the statement: 31.00 (baseline none -> 66.07; the 2025-10-03 waiver is not since the statement and is the near-miss).

[Seed] Customer Desmond Achterberg (phone 4125550268, EIN last4 4127 inside the identifier band), revolving ledger simulated cycle by cycle from 2025-08 to 2026-09: 14 statements, 14 purchases at 7 percent tax, 13 payment lines, 13 interest charges at 27.49 percent over 365 days on the carried balance, two short payments each followed by a 39.00 late fee, one courtesy waiver; ProBuild Silver with 16 spend lines (two bank card purchases). Automatic clauses checked: no statement reaches 60 days past due, interest is owed every cycle because no statement was paid in full, the current minimum is not yet due (due 2026-10-25). current_balance equals the ledger.

[Persona] Desmond, tired tile setter; volunteers only the wish to pay this month's minimum now from business checking; details only when asked; authorizes the debit as owner; if the late fee is raised he does not ask to remove it (no courtesy request), lets the agent post what must be posted, submits the figure he is given and ends on the payment confirmation (the last gold action).

[Verification run] check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK (2 comps, 9 factors, 3 cross-difficulty); handling-time values 31.00 (step 7) and 65.45 (step 9). EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 78 = init 78), SOLVABILITY OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; check_traceability pending the published KB.

[Revisions] (1) lateness share first labelled method, relabelled parameter (its tiers swap a number). (2) The 2025-09-26 late fee could be read as also owing a correction; the seed now carries its 2025-10-03 courtesy waiver so base forbids a reversal and the object is unique; ledger and statements re-simulated and every figure, trace and tracing re-run. (3) Baseline sentences across the charter renamed 'standard ...' so the rule never states two values for one quantity.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the payment rule: the figure waits on corrections; the re-rating rule on the 2026 fee gives 8.00 and an excess of 31.00; after it the payment rule gives 46.95 + 18.50 = 65.45. No second reading: the old fee cannot be reversed, the customer asked for no waiver, and the payment amount is fixed by the rule, not by the customer.

[Difficulty-level closing] Union of the two scopes = all six extended policies (task 0: trade_ext_dispute_settlement_credit, trade_ext_statement_late_charge, trade_ext_phone_payoff, trade_ext_credit_line_sizing; task 1: trade_ext_late_fee_rerating, trade_ext_statement_minimum_payment); scopes and tools pairwise disjoint; each task calls one owner=user tool. Final runs without --task: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 53.50 / steps 13.00, history_rows_max 93, branches_max 74), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK, CACHE-DIFF INFO only. check_traceability: every non-numeric argument traced except the six hidden tool names (unlock/call tool_name), which only the published KB will carry - pending the KB render.

[Round 2 rework - audit audits/policy_task/pro_credit_account_servicing/ (1.md, _difficulty.md)]
- F-2 on P5 (SOURCE-FACTOR): late_fee_repeat_window relabelled parameter (its tiers select a lookback length). The lateness share became the computation's method factor: the guaranteed brief-lateness tier now prorates the fee by days late (days past due / 10 lateness proration days), the other brief tier applies a flat 0.75 share, the fall-through charges the fee whole. Figures unchanged (5 / 10 = 0.50; reversal 31.00; baseline 23.00).
- O-4: the re-rating rule and E4 now speak of 'the most recent late fee', the object compute prices (the 2025 fee is also excluded by its waiver).
- O-5: 'entries posted since the statement date' now defined as the entries carrying the newest entry's period when it is later than the statement's, exactly compute's open_period test.
- O-1: the base application-order sentence is declared superseded in this policy's overwrite.
- Gates re-run: EXTENDED OK, COMPUTE OK with every figure equal to round 1.
user_scenario: You are Desmond Achterberg, who owns Ironbridge Tile & Stone Co., a small tile and stone setting shop in Pittsburgh that buys on a Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge. You are calm, a little tired, and you talk like someone who would rather be on a job site than on the phone. You are calling to make this month's minimum payment on the Pro Revolving Charge by phone right now, from the business checking account, so you do not fall behind again. Cash is tight until a bathroom job closes, so you only want to pay what is needed to cover the minimum on your latest statement today, not the whole balance, and you want it done on this call rather than a quote. You give your details only when asked: the phone number on the profile is 4125550268 and the last four of the EIN are 4127; if the agent wants the business name it is Ironbridge Tile & Stone Co., and the billing ZIP is 15203. You do not remember the balance or the minimum on the statement and you tell the agent to look them up. If the agent asks whether you can authorize the payment, you say you are the owner and you authorize the debit from the business checking account. If the agent mentions the late fee from last month, you say you saw it and figured it was on you for coming up short, and you leave it to the agent; you do not ask for it to be removed. If the agent says something has to be corrected or posted on the account before the payment amount can be settled, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount and hands the payment over to you, you submit it yourself for exactly that amount and read back the confirmation reference you get. If the agent asks you to confirm a figure, you say you do not have the statement handy and you will go with what the system shows. Once the payment has gone through and the agent confirms it, you thank them and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reversal_amount: 31.00. Repeat window: active ProBuild Silver and account open 66 >= 60 months -> member window of 6 months; other late fees in it: 0 (the 2025-09-26 fee is 12 whole months back) -> first-time late fee 25.00 (account open >= 12 months).
